title: Qatar Must Account for Iranian Pilots; They Are “Alive”
text:
Qatar Must Account for Iranian Pilots; They Are “Alive”"

"🔆🔅TEHRAN — October 20, 2026 — The Iranian Army’s deputy chief for legal and parliamentary affairs said the Qatari government must account for the Iranian pilots, stating that Iran considers them “alive” and that Qatar bears “international responsibility.”"

""
"SOT1, Moslem Yaqoubi, Deputy for Legal and Parliamentary Affairs of the Army of the Islamic Republic of Iran(Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:55): "According to documents, evidence, and the Qatari government’s contradictory claims, legally speaking, our presumption is that the pilots are alive. In other words, the principle is that they are alive, because no proof of their martyrdom, or, rather, of their not being alive, has been presented. This is a legal principle, and in our jurisprudence (fiqh) we also have the rule of presumption of continuity, which means maintaining a situation that previously existed. They set out alive and carried out a mission. Our opposing party in this conflict was the Qatari government, of course, Qatar itself was not the opposing party; the American bases located there were the opposing party. But even if a strike occurred, it occurred in the airspace surrounding the Qatari government, and Qatar’s international responsibility remains in place.""

"SOT2, Moslem Yaqoubi, Deputy for Legal and Parliamentary Affairs of the Army of the Islamic Republic of Iran(Farsi)-(00:56 - 01:25): "Basically, under international law, the state hosting the prisoners is responsible for locating them alive, providing medical treatment, giving information to their families, and ultimately handing them over to the competent authorities, whether the Red Cross, a protecting power, or the government of the prisoners’ nationality. In fact, this is an obligation of governments under the Geneva Quartet Conventions.""

"SOT3, Moslem Yaqoubi, Deputy for Legal and Parliamentary Affairs of the Army of the Islamic Republic of Iran(Farsi)-(01:26 - 02:18): "The Geneva Quartet Conventions provide for a specific legal follow-up system; that is, we recognize the International Red Cross as a neutral and supporting organization responsible for follow-up. We have conveyed official correspondence, requests for official visits, and demands to the Qatari government, even at the level of heads of state, and we have reminded it of the Qatari government’s international responsibility. This is because, as you are aware, in the field of international law it is international responsibility that keeps states bound. It is our presumption that they are alive, except for that dear martyr whose body we actually received and whose martyrdom was confirmed to us through DNA testing.""

"SOT4, Moslem Yaqoubi: "We have concluded that their survival is presumed. The Qatari government has provided us with no evidence of their death or martyrdom, the Qatari government’s international responsibility remains in effect, and we are pursuing the matter through international authorities.
